status: declared by the pull request that closes #539 before any score was computed; nothing here is tuned on a scored day; the variants, their inputs and the calibration scheme are the pull request's, stated and not chosen on a score
parents_declaration: metadata/risk_date_severity.json (unchanged: the risk dates, the features, the estimators)

model.formula: P(pressure) = P(risk date) x the passer's own forecast + P(ordinary day) x the every-day hazard
model.weights: whether a day is a risk date is a fact about the calendar known in advance (docs/pivot/construction-gaps-result.md), so P(risk date) is 1 on a risk date and 0 on any other day; a risk date keeps the parent's forecast exactly
model.hazard: a ridge logistic (ml.PRESSURE_LOGISTIC_SETTINGS) of spread > tau, one per threshold, fitted on the direct pairs of every training day under the as-of rule, mapped through the variant's calibration curve

calibration.scheme: walk-forward, refit with the model on the judge's 21-day cut-off cadence: the refit's training pairs, in date order, are cut into ml.HURDLE_CALIBRATION_BLOCKS blocks; the hazard fitted on blocks 0..k-1 forecasts block k (k >= 1) and the curve is fitted on those out-of-sample forecasts and their labels; the final hazard, fitted on every training pair, is mapped through it
calibration.identity_until: the out-of-sample pairs number probability_calibration.MINIMUM_PAIRS (250) and hold MINIMUM_EVENTS (5) events, as the bake-off's gate (#138)

methods.platt: probability_calibration._platt (a logistic of the label on logit(p))
methods.isotonic: probability_calibration._isotonic (the CORP isotonic fit, a right-continuous step function)

model.missing_input: a served day whose hazard inputs are not all public is served the hazard fitted without the missing ones (always including the spread), calibrated the same way, instead of 0
model.regime_input: the as-of reserve scarcity state (scarcity.py, 0 to 3) is the regime-like input of the state variants. The regime labels of metadata/evaluation_splits.json are drawn after the fact (metadata/hindsight_regimes.json) and are not an input: whether they may be is Eleonora's decision

+hurdle_platt.reading: the hazard on spread_bps, sofr_p75_iorb_bps and sofr_p99_iorb_bps, mapped through a Platt curve fitted walk-forward

+hurdle_isotonic.reading: the same hazard, mapped through an isotonic curve fitted walk-forward

+hurdle_state_platt.reading: the hazard on those three and the as-of reserve scarcity state, mapped through a Platt curve fitted walk-forward

+hurdle_state_isotonic.reading: the same four-input hazard, mapped through an isotonic curve fitted walk-forward

cutoffs: the judge's cutoff_rule, from each variant's own training window, unchanged: one cut-off per threshold and horizon
judging: the judge as declared (metadata/pressure_judge.json): tiers 1, 3 and 5, h = 1 to 5, +5 and +10 bp, under the flat and the weighted rule; tier 1 also under readings (b) and (e) of docs/pivot/judge-readings-result.md

log_loss.floor: probability_calibration.PROBABILITY_FLOOR (1e-6): a forecast is clipped to [floor, 1 - floor] before its log loss is taken, so a parent's exact 0 on a pressure day costs ln(1e6)

published: nothing: the variants are off in every published declaration; no rule, threshold, definition or availability time changes
